health_check.endpoint:
jq -er '
if .snapshot_timestamp_utc == null then "FAIL: no snapshot recorded" else
  (now - (.snapshot_timestamp_utc | fromdateiso8601)) as $age_sec |
  if ($age_sec > 100800) then "FAIL: stale (\($age_sec / 3600 | floor) hours old)"
  elif (.restic_exit_code != 0 and .restic_exit_code != 3) then "FAIL: restic exit \(.restic_exit_code)"
  else "OK (\($age_sec / 3600 | floor) hours since snapshot)"
  end
end' /data/services/backup/state/last-backup.json
health_check.expected: exit 0 with an 'OK …' line; the pointer is freshness-checked (snapshot_timestamp_utc must be non-null, within the last 28 hours, and restic_exit_code in {0, 3}). A pointer that exists but is stale or carries a failed exit code MUST fail.
health_check.note: Pointer file is written by /data/services/backup/scripts/backup.sh on every run (#511). Schema v1 fields: snapshot_timestamp_utc (authoritative — derived from `restic snapshots --latest 1 --json` after the run), snapshot_id, restic_exit_code (the backup step's actual exit, not the script's overall exit), script_finished_at_utc (separate witness), repo_size_bytes, snapshot_count, integrity_check_run, integrity_check_passed. Atomic write via .tmp + mv so concurrent readers never see a partial file. See docs/runbooks/restic-backup-ops.md.

Rolls up by canonical title (treating weekday-in-title variants as distinct habits) and emits a WeeklyHabitReport JSON on stdout (--output json, default) or the pre-rendered WhatsApp body (--output text). Per-habit percentage = dedup-by-date completed_count / scheduled_days_in_window * 100; scheduled-days math is 7 for daily-cadence habits (`repeat_after == 86400`) and 1 per matched-weekday occurrence for weekday-in-title habits. Vikunja `done_at` is NOT read for completion history — `repeat_after` recurrence resets that field on each cycle, collapsing daily-habit history to 0% (the original #605 bug). Standard library only beyond the shared client + state-log primitive. Failure mode: typed VikunjaError exceptions propagate to the agent, which renders `Weekly report unavailable: <reason>` rather than fabricating data.

Mission vikunja-client-and-habits-weekly-report-01KTKSFT (#542 foundation): shared stateless Vikunja API client. Errors are redaction-safe by default (include request path, exclude request/response bodies). Standard-library only. Listed here under the habits service because the first consumer ships in this mission; future migrations of scripts/sync/, scripts/habits/, scripts/escalation/, etc. will reference this module from their respective service entries. Architectural NOTE: service-inventory.json has no first-class 'shared library' surface — this entry is registered under the first consuming service per established convention.

services.description: Daily 48hr auto-skip pass for habit check-ins — scans morning-checkin-<date>.json artifacts older than 48hr, appends auto_skipped events to habits-history.jsonl for unresolved habits, and (for day-specific habits) advances Vikunja due_date to the next designated weekday at EOD-ET. Stateless Python oneshot; no LLM calls (mission #408 / Directive 6).
services.exec_start_note: Direct Python driver invocation. Stateless per tick — each run is a fresh process; persistent state is the morning-checkin-*.json artifacts + habits-history.jsonl + the per-tick sweeper-tick-<date>.json + sweeper-ledger.jsonl. Path uses /home/claude/kg-automation/ per the post-#59 cutover convention (not /repos/).
services.output_path: /data/services/openclaw/state/habits/sweeper-tick-<date>.json (overwrite per-day) + /data/services/openclaw/state/habits/sweeper-ledger.jsonl (append-only) + /data/services/openclaw/state/habits-history.jsonl (append auto_skipped events) + Vikunja /tasks/<id> POST (advance due_date for day-specific habits)
services.retention: tick artifacts: latest per-date (overwrite); ledger: append-only; history: append-only (mission-wide retention policy)
services.purpose: Close Kent's 48hr response window on yesterday's (and older) morning check-ins. Records auto_skipped events in habits-history.jsonl (preserving accountability) and, for day-specific habits, advances their Vikunja due_date to the next designated weekday so the habit appears in the right next morning's check-in.

capabilities.calls_vikunja_note: Per-habit POST to /tasks/<id> with {due_date: <next-designated-weekday-EOD-ET>} for day-specific habits only. Daily habits inherit their next instance from Vikunja's native repeat_after cadence — no PUT issued.
capabilities.llm_calls_note: Zero LLM calls. Fully deterministic per Directive 6.

services.name: felix-vikunja-sync-driver
services.schedule_note: 5 minutes after the previous tick exits; first tick 2 minutes after boot; catch-up on resume
services.purpose: Centralized deterministic reconciliation driver for the Felix-Vikunja task + project layers per ADR-0003. Post-#520: full-poll model — fetches GET /tasks/all + GET /projects on every tick (no updated_since delta). 7-phase pipeline (Phase 0 preamble → Phase 1 fetch → Phase 2 set-diff → Phase 3 classify → Phase 4 emit → Phase 5 update → Phase 5b deletion-cleanup → Phase 6 complete). Detects divergences from the local task cache via 3-way set-diff, classifies via UC-1..UC-4, appends conflict rows to conflict-events.jsonl, delivers unsafe-class events via WhatsApp. Also audits the project layer (new/changed/deleted projects stored in project-cache.json for downstream discovery — no WhatsApp delivery for project events). Phase 5b handles task deletions: appends task_deleted to habits-history.jsonl, prunes phase3-schedule.yaml, cache removal in Phase 6. Read-only against Vikunja. Vikunja base URL read from scripts/common/vikunja_config.py at every cycle start (env var VIKUNJA_BASE_URL → /data/services/openclaw/config/vikunja-base-url.txt).

services.name: felix-deployer
services.description: Pull-based deploy applier — reads deploys/queued/, applies via scripts/deploy/lib/, dispatches ntfy.sh push notification on failure. systemd --user Type=oneshot, 5-min timer.
services.purpose: Pull-based deploy applier on office2. On every 5-minute tick it git-pulls main, scans deploys/queued/<manifest>.yaml for new deploy manifests, and applies them through scripts/deploy/lib/apply.py::dry_run_then_apply_gate. Successful manifests move to deploys/applied/<ts>-<name>.yaml; failures move to deploys/failed/<ts>-<name>.yaml and trigger an ntfy.sh push notification to the operator (substrate set by #595; replaces broken openclaw-cron WhatsApp DM path). Stateless per tick — state lives entirely in the deploys/ directory plus state/last-tick.json.
environment_files: /home/claude/.config/felix-deployer/env — provides FELIX_DEPLOYER_NTFY_TOPIC for ntfy.sh dispatch; non-fatal if missing per systemd EnvironmentFile=- directive; added by #595
outbound_dependencies: ntfy.sh:443/tcp — HTTPS POST for failure notifications; added by #595

dependencies.description: Failure-path notification is dispatched via HTTPS POST to https://ntfy.sh/<topic> using curl --max-time 10.
